description:
Fingerprint fast-paths currently ignore core logical structure (join conditions,
grouping, projections, limits/offsets), so materially different plans hash the
same and are marked identical. Stored fingerprints are also trusted on ingest,
allowing stale/tampered hashes to bypass comparison. Tighten the structural
signature, recompute/verify fingerprints on load and before comparison, and
update regression/summary flows to refuse hashes that don’t match the current
tree. Ensure plan history and CLI outputs surface verification failures cleanly.
